settings.note: Defaults otherwise (depth 10). --max-pages 0 lifts the default 500-page cap so the whole site is audited. AVC_DATA_DIR is a throwaway folder deleted after the run.

settings.route: local engine HTTP API (uvicorn sentinelseo.web.api:app), as scripts/scheduled_audit.py uses it

crawl.note: all other crawl settings are Scrawly defaults (js_render on, respect_robots on, discover_sitemap on)

settings.localhost: no private-IP/localhost blocking exists in the crawler; nothing had to be enabled

settings.config: default (all categories incl. agentic-browsing; mobile; simulated throttling)
settings.pageList: start URL + sitemap URLs (robots.txt Sitemap lines, else /sitemap.xml), first 50
settings.failure: an audit is a finding when its score is below 0.9 (Lighthouse pass threshold); informative/manual/n.a. audits ignored
settings.runs: one page at a time, sequentially; durationMs and peakRssMb are the sum and the max over pages

settings.defaults: crawler + robots.txt + sitemap, dynamicSampling 8, maxRoutes 200, mobile, 4 categories (no agentic-browsing by default)
settings.failure: audit score < 0.9 in the per-route Lighthouse report

settings.note: follow links is the default; --analyze-headings/--analyze-extra-tags only add data, not warnings, so they were left off
